en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, form Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem with encircling the sword with the gold and the silver’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not unlawful to decorate the sword with gold and silver.’”
